evals.name: design-list-endpoint
evals.prompt: Design a GET /api/v1/users endpoint with pagination, status filtering, and sorting.
evals.expected_output: A RESTful endpoint design using Gorilla Mux, standard query params, and envelope response.
assertions: Uses query parameters limit and offset (or cursor) with default bounds.
Returns response envelope with data list and pagination metadata (page, total).
Handles invalid query parameter values with HTTP 400 Bad Request.

evals.name: standard-error-envelope
evals.prompt: Design the error response schema for API failures across the microservice.
evals.expected_output: Consistent error JSON contract with error code, message, request ID, and optional field violations.
assertions: Error payload contains code, message, and correlation request_id.
Validation errors include a list of field-level violation details.
Consistent structure across 4xx and 5xx status codes.

evals.name: http-status-code-semantics
evals.prompt: Map domain outcomes (created, entity not found, invalid state transition, internal failure) to HTTP codes.
evals.expected_output: Correct mapping to 201 Created with Location header, 404 Not Found, 409 Conflict / 422, and 500.
assertions: Resource missing maps to 404 Not Found.
Invalid state transition maps to 409 Conflict or 422 Unprocessable Entity.
